category_insight: TikTok Shop success hinges on visual surprise, clear product benefit, and emotional triggers tied to lifestyle or pain points (e.g., ‘no watering,’ ‘perfect fit,’ ‘affordability’). Replication is high when visuals are clean, hooks are bold, and social proof is absent — making trust-building and urgency critical.
winning_patterns: Hook must be bold or surprising within 3 seconds
Visuals must be aspirational or relatable to buyer’s lifestyle
Emotional triggers must align with pain points (e.g., ‘no maintenance,’ ‘perfect fit,’ ‘affordable luxury’)
CTA must be explicit (e.g., ‘Buy Now,’ ‘Tap to Shop,’ ‘Limited Stock’)
Social proof is non-negotiable — even 1-2 user testimonials or before/after clips boost conversion
Urgency and scarcity (e.g., ‘Only 5 left,’ ‘Limited time offer’) are essential for purchase triggers
Price comparison or ‘only at Costco’/‘Amazon bestseller’ badges build trust and value
buyer_triggers: Trust through brand or expert endorsement
creative_rules: Always include 3-second CTA — no implicit ‘add to cart’
Use text overlays for key benefits (e.g., ‘No watering,’ ‘Only $X’)
Include 1-2 user testimonials or before/after clips
Add ‘Limited stock’ or ‘Only 5 left’ to trigger FOMO
Use ‘Costco Savvy’ or ‘Amazon Bestseller’ to build trust
Repurpose as ‘DIY Challenge’ or ‘Before/After’ series for UGC
avoid: No social proof — no reviews, no testimonials
No clear CTA — no ‘Buy Now’ or ‘Tap to Shop’
No emotional trigger — no ‘I need this’ or ‘I’m tired of fake trees’
No trust indicators — no brand logo, no expert, no comparison
